name: Isomesh
definition: A visualization technique that triangulates the level set of a plotted 3D field using marching cubes and draws it as a shaded, depth-tested mesh, replacing the volume rendering approach which ray-marches a shell and suffers from striping or lack of depth testing.
summary: Isomesh extracts 3D isosurfaces via Marching Cubes and renders them as depth-tested meshes, eliminating volume rendering artifacts like striping and occlusion errors.
